profile.headline: Software Engineer | Mobile Solutions Architect | Android Developer
profile.summary:
I'm an experienced Principal Software Engineer with a passion for building high-impact Android applications that users love. I thrive on tackling complex challenges and delivering innovative solutions that drive results.  My expertise lies in:
• Architecting robust and scalable systems: Designing and implementing efficient architectures that can handle millions of users and ensure seamless app performance, even under heavy load.
• Modernizing legacy codebases: Breathing new life into existing applications by integrating cutting-edge technologies like Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and Dagger, resulting in improved performance, maintainability, and scalability.
• Optimizing for user experience: Creating intuitive and engaging user interfaces that delight users and contribute to top app store ratings.
• Driving growth and engagement: Developing features and functionalities that attract new users, increase engagement, and contribute to significant download growth.

I've consistently delivered exceptional results in fast-paced environments, including leading the development of the Yahoo Sports app, which achieved a 4.7 star rating (the highest across the Yahoo suite) and saw a >100% increase in downloads during my tenure.

I'm eager to connect with companies who are looking for a skilled and passionate Android developer to help them build innovative and engaging mobile experiences.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead mobile architecture and core platform initiatives across the connected vehicle digital ecosystem (Ford, Lincoln, Ford Pro, Wear OS).
• Cross-Platform Architecture: Designed and deployed a centralized Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) Observability & Logging SDK adopted across mobile and wearable applications.  
• Build System & CI/CD Modernization: Led Kapt-to-KSP build migration, automated CI/CD validation pipelines (JFrog, automated PR quality gates), and standardized enterprise dependency injection (Dagger/Hilt).  
• Engineering Governance: Introduced codebase-level Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and custom lint checks to maintain code quality across distributed feature teams.
positions.insights: Skills: Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) · Jetpack Compose · Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead key architectural improvements for Yahoo Sports, including the adoption of modern Android development practices, migrating the codebase to ~80% Kotlin, and introducing Jetpack Compose alongside existing XML-based UI.
• Championed the migration to Dagger2 for dependency injection, Glide for image loading, and a modularized app structure for enhanced maintainability and scalability.
• Continued development and support of the Yahoo Sports app, achieving the highest app store rating (4.7) across the entire Yahoo suite and earning the distinction of being the sole "Editors' Choice" app.
• Drove a significant increase in app downloads to 10 million through strategic feature implementation and performance optimization.
• Enhanced app reliability and efficiency by transitioning from AsyncTask-based services to coroutine/flow-based services and implementing robust background task management with WorkManager.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented and maintained multiple versions of Yahoo Sports.  
• Oversaw broad increase in downloads from 100K -> 5M, with DAUs ranging from 300-600K
• Maintained a rating of 4.5 – 4.7, utilizing several feedback tools and SDKs
• Resilient design kept crash rate steady at < 0.2%
• Maintained a cold start time of < 2s utilizing standard tools and Nimbledroid API
• Introduced Kotlin and assisted in Coroutine integration, achieving ~20% code migration.
• Successfully designed, implemented and deployed major features like NFL Live Stream, NBA League Pass, Billion Dollar Bracket Challenge for March Madness, World Cup, and Breaking News notifications.
• Redesigned the entire app for Material Design, including bottom navigation and collapsing toolbar layout.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
• Designed, developed and deployed ZixOne – a BYOD enterprise mobile solution.
• Architected the Android email client using common Android components, including GCM for notifications.
• Architected RESTful JSON back-end web services in Java.  Technologies included Apache Tomee, Guava, JAX-RS and Hibernate ORM.
positions.insights: Skills: Android Development · Java · Agile Methodologies · Git · Ant

positions.title: Senior Consultant (formerly Vlingo acquired by Nuance)
positions.description:
• Implemented and maintained multiple versions of SVoice – a personal assistant app on Android, pre-loaded on Samsung Galaxy series phones (Note, S II and S III) for tens of millions of users.
• Redesigned and refactored the HTTP module for voice recognition.
• Successfully upgraded the existing codebase from 2.3 (Gingerbread) to 4.0 (Ice Cream Sandwich).
positions.insights: Skills: Android Development · AOSP · Java · Ant · Subversion

positions.title: Software Engineer (formerly Shared Technologies acquired by Arrow)
positions.description:
• Designed, implemented, deployed and maintained multiple web apps for companywide CRM, ERP, ITS, analytics and security tools.
• Languages included Java, HTML, Apache Velocity, SQL, and Linux shell scripts.
• Deployed on RHEL with Technologies including Apache Tomcat, JAX-WS, JUnit, Ant, Emma, and Hudson.
• Prototyped Android apps for 1) field technician GPS tracking and dispatching and 2) external customer ITS.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Java · MySQL · JAX-WS · Tomcat

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed, implemented, integrated and supported the Tellabs 1090 Element Management Software, including new functionality for SIP, IPSec, performance monitoring, and report generation. 
• Languages included C++, Java, and UNIX shell scripts.
• Assisted in implementing a new SOAP interface utilizing a Spring MVC design and incorporating Maven build management with a Tomcat back end.
• Authored engineering documents for build procedures, sanity testing, Functional Design Specifications and formal reviews using UML for use cases and diagrams.
• Represented the development group for CMMI audits, achieving levels 2 and 3.

positions.title: Software Developer (formerly Advanced Fibre Communications acquired by Tellabs)
positions.description:
• Designed, implemented and maintained a custom Network Management System in Java with Adventnet WebNMS, which served as a real-time monitoring solution across VPN links to over 100 Tellabs customers.
• Deployed 3-tiered application on Windows using Oracle 10g databases, with Tomcat back-end and multiple front-end servers.
• Refined Oracle database schema, allowing for performance monitoring data scaled to over 2M rows per day.

projects.title: Fantasy Forecast -- Android App for Fantasy Football
projects.description:
Get all your weekly NFL player forecasts with Fantasy Forecast! 
This app averages many different forecasting sites to give fantasy football owners the most accurate forecasts around.
Allows users to set their fantasy league rules and displays player forecasts per position per week.
